jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Do you excel at turning complexity into clarity? Are you energized by shaping ideas, challenging assumptions, and amplifying a leader’s impact?
We are seeking a New Builds Development & Delivery Manager who will act as an extension of the Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, enhancing strategic thinking, improving decision‑making speed, and helping bring robust, high-quality concepts to senior leadership.
This role is not operational and not a presentation-updating position. It is a partnership role, designed for someone who can think critically, structure ambiguous problems, challenge insights, and support the development of transformational guest experience concepts.You will collaborate closely with stakeholders across Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, and Strategy, ensuring concepts are analytically sound, insight-driven, and aligned with the company expectations. You’ll gain exposure to strategic discussions, influence senior decision-making, and drive clarity across innovation workstreams.
If you are a sharp thinker, a natural challenger, and a trusted partner able to elevate the work of others, this is the role for you

Your Impact

Strategic Support & Thought Partnership

- Act as a direct strategic partner to the Senior Manager, helping structure thinking, frame problems, and sharpen concept narratives.

- Participate in or lead selected meetings on behalf of Guest Experience Innovation

- Prepare strategic briefs, decision frameworks, and synthesis documents for SVP-level conversations.

Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Communication

- Craft clear, concise, and strategically sound storytelling materials for leadership forums

- Transform complex information into high-impact narratives.

- Support leadership in preparing for SVP/EVP/Executive Committee discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Engage with Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy, and Operations teams to gather insights and shape concepts.

- Lead the development and delivery of new entertainment concepts, experiences, and spaces across our fleet.

- Act as the key link between creative partners, operations, and corporate functions, ensuring alignment and buy-in at every stage.

Project & Stakeholder Management

- Drive clarity in workstreams by structuring timelines, identifying decision points, and anticipating risks.

- Follow up with stakeholders to ensure progress and alignment.

- Elevate issues early and propose mitigation scenarios.

Your Journey so far

- 5–8 years in strategy, innovation, business design, consulting, or strategic project management.

- Experience in hospitality, cruise, retail, consumer goods, or guest experience is a strong plus.

- Strong background in designing and executing guest-focused experiences, from concept to delivery.

- A balance of creativity and operational know-how, able to dream big and deliver practically.

- Proven track record in managing complex, cross-functional teams (operations, creative, marketing, sales, revenue, communications), with the ability to unite diverse perspectives around a single vision.

- Excellent knowledge of modern visual communication tools (Canva, Adobe Suite, AI-driven creative platforms) to produce compelling visual documents and storytelling assets beyond traditional slide decks.

- Excellent relationship-building skills; able to inspire, influence, and connect across diverse teams.

- Strong storytelling and presentation skills, with confidence at the executive level.

- Ability to travel 20-30% of the time.

- Fluent English; additional languages a plus.

Your Essentials

- Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- EU Passport or right to work in Switzerland.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

• Stiamo cercando un New Builds Development & Delivery Manager che agirà come estensione del Senior Manager of Concept Innovation, migliorando il pensiero strategico, migliorando la velocità decisionale e aiutando a portare concetti robusti e di alta qualità alla leadership senior. Questo ruolo non è operativo e non è una posizione di presentazione. Si tratta di un ruolo di partnership, progettato per qualcuno che può pensare criticamente, strutturare problemi ambigui, sfidare intuizioni e sostenere lo sviluppo di concetti di esperienza degli ospiti trasformazionali. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con le parti interessate attraverso Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild e Strategy, assicurando che i concetti siano analiticamente sani, orientati agli insight e allineati alle aspettative dell'azienda. Potrai ottenere l'esposizione a discussioni strategiche, influenzare il processo decisionale senior, e guidare la chiarezza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di innovazione. Se sei un pensatore acuto, un sfidante naturale, e un partner affidabile in grado di elevare il lavoro degli altri, questo è il ruolo per voi Il tuo impatto Supporto strategico e partenariato di pensiero - Agire come partner strategico diretto al Senior Manager, aiutando il pensiero della struttura, i problemi della struttura e affinare le narrazioni dei concetti. - Partecipare o condurre riunioni selezionate per conto dell'Innovazione dell'esperienza ospite - Preparare brevi strategici, quadri decisionali e documenti di sintesi per conversazioni a livello SVP. Narrative Building & Executive-Ready Comunicazione - Materiali di storytelling chiari, concisi e strategicamente sani per forum di leadership - Trasformare informazioni complesse in narrazioni ad alto impatto. - Sostenere la leadership nella preparazione delle discussioni del Comitato SVP/EVP/Executive. Collaborazione trasversale - Coinvolgere con i team Experience, Entertainment, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild, Strategy e Operations per raccogliere idee e concetti di forma. - Condurre lo sviluppo e la consegna di nuovi concetti di intrattenimento, esperienze e spazi attraverso la nostra flotta. - Agire come il collegamento chiave tra partner creativi, operazioni e funzioni aziendali, garantendo allineamento e buy-in in ogni fase. Project & Stakeholder Management - Guidare la chiarezza nei flussi di lavoro strutturando le linee temporali, identificare i punti di decisione e anticipare i rischi. - Seguire con gli stakeholder per garantire il progresso e l'allineamento. - Elevare i problemi presto e proporre scenari di mitigazione. Il tuo viaggio finora - 5-8 anni di strategia, innovazione, business design, consulenza o gestione strategica del progetto. - L'esperienza in ospitalità, crociera, vendita al dettaglio, beni di consumo, o l'esperienza degli ospiti è un vantaggio forte. - Forte sfondo nella progettazione e nell'esecuzione di esperienze orientate agli ospiti, dal concetto alla consegna. - Un equilibrio di creatività e know-how operativo, in grado di sognare grande e consegnare praticamente. - Provato track record nella gestione di team complessi e interfunzionali (operazioni, creativo, marketing, vendite, ricavi, comunicazioni), con la capacità di unire prospettive diverse intorno a una singola visione. - Ottima conoscenza dei moderni strumenti di comunicazione visiva (Canva, Adobe Suite, piattaforme creative basate su AI) per produrre documenti visivi e attività di storytelling oltre i tradizionali ponti di scorrimento. - Eccellente capacità di costruzione di relazioni; in grado di ispirare, influenzare e connettersi tra diverse squadre. - Forte capacità di narrazione e presentazione, con fiducia a livello esecutivo. - Capacità di viaggiare 20-30% del tempo. - Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive a plus. I tuoi essenziali - Proficienza in Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook. - EU Passport o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Können Sie Komplexität in Klarheit verwandeln? Werden Sie durch die Gestaltung von Ideen, die Herausforderung von Annahmen und die Verstärkung der Wirkung eines Führers angetrieben? Wir suchen einen New Builds Development & Delivery Manager, der als Erweiterung des Senior Manager of Concept Innovation fungiert, das strategische Denken verbessert, die Entscheidungsgeschwindigkeit verbessert und dazu beiträgt, robuste, qualitativ hochwertige Konzepte in die Geschäftsleitung zu bringen. Diese rolle ist nicht operativ und keine präsentationsaktualisierungsposition. Es ist eine Partnerschaftsrolle, die für jemanden gedacht ist, der kritisch denken, mehrdeutige Probleme strukturieren, Insights herausfordern und die Entwicklung transformierender Gästeerlebniskonzepte unterstützen kann. Sie arbeiten eng mit Stakeholdern aus den Bereichen Experience, Retail, Marketing, Newbuild und Strategie zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Konzepte analytisch fundiert, aufschlussreich und auf die Erwartungen des Unternehmens ausgerichtet sind. Sie werden sich strategischen Diskussionen aussetzen, die Entscheidungsfindung von Führungskräften beeinflussen und Klarheit über Innovations-Workstreams hinweg schaffen. Wenn Sie ein scharfer Denker, ein natürlicher Herausforderer und ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner sind, der in der Lage ist, die Arbeit anderer zu erhöhen, ist dies die Rolle für Sie Ihre Wirkung Strategische Unterstützung & Thought Partnerschaft - Handeln Sie als direkter strategischer Partner des Senior Managers und helfen Sie dabei, das Denken zu strukturieren, Probleme zu formulieren und Konzeptnarrative zu schärfen. - Nehmen Sie an ausgewählten Meetings teil oder leiten Sie diese im Namen von Guest Experience Innovation Bereiten Sie strategische Briefings, Entscheidungsrahmen und Synthesedokumente für Gespräche auf SVP-Ebene vor. Narrative Gebäude & Executive-Ready Kommunikation Erstellen Sie klare, prägnante und strategisch fundierte Storytelling-Materialien für Führungsforen Verwandeln Sie komplexe Informationen in wirkungsvolle Narrative. - Unterstützung der Führung bei der Vorbereitung der SVP/EVP/Exekutivausschuss-Gespräche. Ausgezeichnete beziehungsaufbauende fähigkeiten; in der lage, verschiedene teams zu inspirieren, zu beeinflussen und zu verbinden. Starke Storytelling- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten, mit Vertrauen auf Führungsebene. - Fähigkeit, 20-30% der Zeit zu reisen. - fließendes Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen ein Plus. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Maßnahmen, die sich langfristig positiv auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten auswirken. Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Begleiten Sie uns auf MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten auf Sie warten. Bewerben sie sich noch heute, um teil eines globalen teams zu sein, das grenzen überschreitet und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

jobs.title: Marketing Full Funnel Analyst
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong marketing, digital and commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

- The objective of the role is to optimize full-funnel marketing investments holistically, maximizing revenue impact and ROI optimization across markets. This role is responsible for analysing performance across the customer journey — from awareness through loyalty — to identify growth opportunities, improve marketing efficiency, and drive commercial outcomes through data-driven decision-making.
Performance analysis: monitor and analyse marketing performance against brand and commercial KPIs, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key marketing KPIs across touchpoint (all paid, owned and earned channels), campaigns and audience performance.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by campaign, touchpoint and audience for each market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact activities, to hit awareness and revenue targets.

- Build and maintain full-funnel performance scorecards by market (awareness → consideration → conversion → loyalty) to identify revenue bottlenecks and optimize budget allocation between markets. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Develop attribution models (e.g.  media mix, multi-touch attribution) to clarify revenue contribution across platforms and improve investment efficiency.

- Partner with Marketing & Digital heads, Finance, Commercial and Revenue teams to forecast investment impacts and align marketing activities with commercial outcomes.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in marketing analytics, commercial analytics, business intelligence, or performance marketing analysis.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of marketing measurement methodologies including attribution modelling, media mix modelling, customer segmentation, and ROI analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.title: Junior Architect Port Development Intern
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.

An exciting opportunity exists for a talented, skilled at analysis, strategic and highly organized professional with strong commercial acumen to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys, based in our offices in Geneva, Switzerland.

Your Impact

The objective of the role is to optimize DTC performance, identify and drive key levers, increase conversion rate to drive channel revenue, effectiveness and efficiency.
Optimize Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) performance by identifying and activating key growth levers that improve revenue generation across markets and Business-to-Consumer (B2C) sub-channels, conversion, channel effectiveness and operational and investment efficiency.

- Performance analysis: monitor and analyse performance against channel and commercial KPIs, providing channel-specific insights and recommendations by market to maximize revenue per B2C sub-channel (Web, Call Centre and Future Sales) and drive continuous improvement. Own the development, tracking and actioning of key KPIs.

- Drive efficiency, quantifying ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA by sub-channel by market to continuously optimize investments. Recommend reinvestments toward highest-impact channels.

- Develop attribution models to identify channel levers which drive revenue.

- Build and maintain B2C performance scorecards by market to monitor and optimize B2C channel performance, identifying drop-off points. Both on Excel and partnering with corporate team to make it available in self-serve tools (Power BI).

- Partner with Media, Digital, Commercial, Revenue, IT, Call Centre and Future Sales to improve customer journeys, reduce friction, increase conversion, repeat and customer lifetime value.

- Competitive analysis: monitor market conditions, competitive activity, and industry trends to support strategic planning and identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Prepare executive-ready presentations, with clear data-based recommendations to support senior leadership strategic decision-making, leveraging stellar data visualization combined with depth of insights.

Your Journey so far

- 5+ years of prior experience in commercial analytics, business intelligence, DTC analytics or eCommerce performance.

- Preference for prior experience in the luxury hospitality/travel industry or consulting agencies.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, or related field (Masters, MBA or equivalent experience preferred).

Your Essentials

- Proven experience supporting senior executives and thriving in a fast-paced, start-up environment, managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

- Highly Proficient in Excel and comfortable manipulating large datasets data and maintaining large spreadsheets with high level of accuracy

- Outstanding PowerPoint and storytelling skills — able to craft clean, crisp, high-impact presentations for C-suite audiences.

- Experience working with Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics or similar platforms, as well as BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of direct sales channels

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in English.

- Passion and curiosity to continuously learn about the ever-evolving travel industry.

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario.

Il tuo scopo

Explora Journeys è un marchio di lusso europeo vibrante, cosmopolita, immaginato nel cuore dell'ospitalità svizzera a Ginevra. Sfruttando le centinaia di anni di esperienza marittima della nostra società madre MSC Group, la nostra flotta di sei navi di lusso (quattro attualmente in cantiere) sono state costruite e progettate in modo totalmente diverso e unico che trasformeranno e ridefiniranno l'esperienza di crociera, creando una categoria propria, attraendo la prossima generazione di viaggiatori di lusso.

Esiste un'opportunità entusiasmante per un talentuoso, esperto di analisi, un professionista strategico e altamente organizzato con un forte acume commerciale per unire il nostro nuovo marchio di viaggio di lusso Explora Journeys, con sede nei nostri uffici a Ginevra, in Svizzera.

Il tuo impatto

L'obiettivo del ruolo è quello di ottimizzare le prestazioni DTC, identificare e guidare le leve chiave, aumentare il tasso di conversione per guidare le entrate del canale, l'efficacia e l'efficienza.
Ottimizzare le prestazioni Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) identificando e attivando leve di crescita chiave che migliorano la generazione dei ricavi su mercati e sub-canale Business-to-Consumer (B2C), conversione, efficacia dei canali e efficienza operativa e di investimento.

- Analisi delle prestazioni: monitorare e analizzare le prestazioni contro i canali e i KPI commerciali, fornendo intuizioni e raccomandazioni specifiche del canale per il mercato per massimizzare i ricavi per il sub-canale B2C (Web, Call Centre e Future Sales) e guidare il miglioramento continuo. Possedere lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e l'azione dei KPI chiave.

- Efficienza di trasmissione, quantificazione ROI/ROAS/CPA/CPLA da sottocanale da mercato per ottimizzare continuamente gli investimenti. Raccomanda reinvestimenti verso i canali più elevati di impatto.

- Sviluppare modelli di attribuzione per identificare leve del canale che guidano le entrate.

- Costruire e mantenere le schede di rendimento B2C per mercato per monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni del canale B2C, identificare i punti di drop-off. Sia in Excel che in collaborazione con il team aziendale per renderlo disponibile negli strumenti self-serve (Power BI).

- Partner con Media, Digital, Commerciale, Vendite, IT, Call Centre e Future Sales per migliorare i viaggi dei clienti, ridurre l'attrito, aumentare la conversione, ripetere e il valore della vita del cliente.

- Analisi competitiva: monitorare le condizioni di mercato, l'attività competitiva e le tendenze del settore per sostenere la pianificazione strategica e identificare le opportunità di differenziazione e crescita.

- Preparare presentazioni esecutive, con chiare raccomandazioni basate sui dati per supportare il processo decisionale strategico di leadership senior, sfruttando la visualizzazione dei dati stellari combinata con la profondità di insight.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- 5+ anni di esperienza precedente in analisi commerciali, intelligenza aziendale, analisi DTC o prestazioni di eCommerce.

- Preferenza per esperienza precedente nel settore dell'ospitalità di lusso / viaggio o agenzie di consulenza.

- Corso di laurea in Business, Economia, Finanza, Marketing, Commerciale o relativo campo (Master, MBA o equivalente esperienza preferita).

I tuoi essenziali

- Esperienza comprovata che supporta i dirigenti senior e prospera in un ambiente di avvio veloce, gestendo contemporaneamente più priorità.

- Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di tradurre i dati complessi in insight aziendali attuabili.

- Eccellente in Excel e confortevole manipolazione di dati di grandi dimensioni e mantenimento di grandi fogli di calcolo con alto livello di precisione

- eccezionali competenze di PowerPoint e storytelling — in grado di creare presentazioni pulite, croccanti, ad alto impatto per il pubblico C-suite.

- Esperienza di lavoro con Salesforce, Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics o piattaforme simili, nonché strumenti BI e di visualizzazione come Tableau, Power BI, Looker o piattaforme simili.

Dein Zweck

Explora Journeys ist eine lebendige, kosmopolitische, europäische Luxusmarke, die im Herzen der Schweizer Gastfreundschaft in Genf vorgestellt wird. Durch die Nutzung der hundertjährigen maritimen Expertise unserer Muttergesellschaft MSC Group wird unsere Flotte von sechs Luxusschiffen (vier derzeit in der Pipeline) auf eine völlig andere und einzigartige Weise gebaut und entworfen, die das Kreuzfahrterlebnis verändern und neu definieren und eine eigene Kategorie schaffen wird, die die nächste Generation von Luxusreisenden anspricht.

Eine aufregende Gelegenheit besteht für einen talentierten, fachkundigen, strategischen und hoch organisierten Fachmann mit starkem Geschäftssinn, sich unserer neu geschaffenen Luxusreisemarke Explora Journeys anzuschließen, die in unseren Büros in Genf, Schweiz, ansässig ist.

Ihre Wirkung

Das Ziel der Rolle ist es, die DTC-Leistung zu optimieren, Schlüsselhebel zu identifizieren und zu steuern, die Conversion-Rate zu erhöhen, um Kanaleinnahmen, Effektivität und Effizienz zu steigern.
Optimieren Sie die Direct-to-Consumer-Performance (DTC), indem Sie wichtige Wachstumshebel identifizieren und aktivieren, die die Umsatzgenerierung in allen Märkten und B2C-Subkanälen (Business-to-Consumer) sowie die Conversion-, Channel-Effektivität und die Betriebs- und Investitionseffizienz verbessern.

Leistungsanalyse: Überwachung und Analyse der Leistung anhand von Channel- und kommerziellen KPIs, Bereitstellung kanalspezifischer Erkenntnisse und Empfehlungen nach Markt, um den Umsatz pro B2C-Subkanal (Web, Call Center und Future Sales) zu maximieren und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Eigenständig für die Entwicklung, Verfolgung und Aktion von wichtigen KPIs.

The Digital Analytics Strategy, Testing and CRO Manager will be responsible for driving D2C growth through data-driven experimentation and strategic optimization of our direct digital channels. This role will have a strong strategic focus on the direct channel, optimizing lead generation, and leveraging insights to drive higher customer acquisition, engagement, and lifetime value.

• Design and execute a comprehensive data driven strategy across all digital touchpoints, with particular focus on driving direct channel growth and reducing acquisition costs through improved conversion rates.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, design, engineering, marketing, and web analytics to conceptualize and design A/B tests that effectively measure the impact of website and campaign changes.

descriptionByLocale.de: Dein Zweck Wir suchen einen dynamischen und hochmotivierten Mobile App Produktspezialisten, der sich unserem Business Innovation Team am MSC Cruises Hauptsitz in Genf anschließt. descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Nous recherchons un spécialiste des produits Mobile App très motivé pour rejoindre notre équipe Business Innovation au siège MSC Cruises à Genève. Ce rôle est conçu pour un professionnel axé sur les données, doté d'un sens commercial fort, d'un état d'esprit analytique et d'une passion pour l'optimisation des parcours des utilisateurs mobiles. Le candidat retenu explorera les comportements dans l'application, éliminera les frictions dans l'entonnoir de vente, et animera des initiatives axées sur les produits pour maximiser les taux de conversion et façonner l'avenir des expériences d'invités numériques dans l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. Votre impact - Analyser le parcours utilisateur et le comportement de MSC for Me pour identifier les goulets d'étranglement, proposer et valider des initiatives de produits qui optimisent l'entonnoir de vente et boostent les taux de conversion dans l'application. - Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles de produit, de technologie et d'UX/UI pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des caractéristiques qui favorisent l'acquisition organique des utilisateurs et augmentent les possibilités de vente croisée/up-seller pour l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. - Mettre en oeuvre et optimiser la position d'application des offres commerciales (travaillant à la fermeture avec le service commercial de Revenus embarqués) pour maximiser la visibilité et les conversions de ventes spécifiquement pour les utilisateurs mobiles. - Utiliser des outils avancés d'analyse de produits et de visualisation des données (Power BI) pour suivre les performances de vente, les taux d'activation des utilisateurs et les retombées dans l'écosystème numérique MSC for Me. - Agir comme un pont entre le service commercial des revenus à bord et les équipes de tech/développement, transformant les objectifs de revenus en exigences de produits numériques claires pour améliorer l'écosystème numérique du SMC pour moi. - Conduire l'acquisition de MSC pour moi par canal en raffinant les fonctionnalités natives de l'application – comme les flux d'utilisateurs invités à enregistrer sans friction, les mécanismes d'invitation à un ami et le partage d'applications sans faille – pour accroître la base d'utilisateurs. - Effectuer des essais A/B sur les flux de ventes MSC pour moi dans l'application, les processus de caisse et les modèles d'abonnement afin d'améliorer continuellement l'efficacité opérationnelle et la production de revenus. Votre voyage jusqu'à présent - Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en administration des affaires, économie, gestion du marketing, numérique ou un domaine connexe. - Fortes compétences commerciales et analytiques avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience prouvée dans les ventes numériques, la croissance de produits, ou le développement d'entreprises numériques, avec un accent strict sur les applications mobiles. - Expérience pratique avec l'analyse des applications, l'optimisation des taux de conversion (CRO) et les outils de manipulation/visualisation des données (Power BI, SQL; Python est un plus). - Familiarité avec les méthodologies agiles et la capacité de travailler côte à côte avec les développeurs et les gestionnaires de produits dans des environnements dynamiques et rapides. - Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration, avec la capacité de traduire les connaissances basées sur les données en recommandations opérationnelles et de produits réalisables. - Un penseur créatif avec une approche proactive à la résolution de problèmes, capable de stimuler la "croissance axée sur les produits" plutôt que de compter sur les dépenses de marketing traditionnelles. - L'anglais et les autres langues européennes sont un plus. Vos essentiels - Compréhension approfondie du comportement des utilisateurs mobiles, des entonnoirs de vente numériques et des écosystèmes d'acquisition axés sur les produits. - Forte entreprise avec un accent sur la maximisation de la valeur de vie du client (CLV) et l'élimination des frictions de l'expérience d'achat mobile. - Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et d'obtenir des résultats de haute qualité dans des délais serrés.
